summary: Master safety team collaboration and OHS leadership. Learn to implement ISO 45001 standards and build a high-performance safety culture. Enroll today.
lede: Safety team collaboration training helps occupational safety and operations professionals coordinate hazard management across teams. Participants practice assessing safety maturity, building shared risk registers, and communicating risks, then develop skills in cross-functional safety committees and joint incident investigations using root cause analysis. The course also covers emergency response coordination and safety performance dashboards.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals responsible for the design, implementation, and oversight of safety protocols within complex operational environments.
modules: Safety Maturity and the Bradley Curve
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of experience in a safety-related role or operational management. Familiarity with basic occupational health and safety (OHS) concepts is required. No prior experience with ISO 45001 is necessary, as foundational elements will be covered.
